limits.en: Non-Commercial edition is free for personal/non-commercial use, with image resolution capped at 1280x1280, excludes some specialized operators, limited to 10 keys per account, forum support only.

keyLimits.en: Free for personal/non-commercial use; resolution capped at 1280x1280, excludes some operators, 10 keys per account, forum support only.
Non-commercial/educational use only; requires student or institution registration and Derivative approval.
Required for any paid/commercial project; unlocks unlimited resolution, H.264/H.265 realtime encoding, Shared Memory and DirectX operators, TouchEngine integration, transferable license keys.
Includes 6 hours of Pro Support, unlimited Notch operator resolution, advanced tracking (Stype, BlackTrax), file privacy protection, motion channel blending.

addOns.en: Floating Cloud Commercial license: $900 USD, for cloud/floating deployment instead of a single dongle-bound seat.

cautions.en: Licenses are perpetual one-time purchases per seat rather than a recurring subscription; the free Non-Commercial tier cannot legally be used for any paid project.

capabilities.en: Node-based visual programming environment for real-time interactive visuals, projection and installations.
Realtime video encoding, TouchEngine integration to embed TouchDesigner networks in other applications, and advanced motion-tracking device support (Commercial/Pro tiers).

limitations.en: Non-Commercial free tier is capped at 1280x1280 resolution and excludes several specialized operators.
Any commercial or compensated use legally requires purchasing a Commercial or Pro license; the free tier cannot be used for paid work.
